seoTitle: Hourly to Salary Calculator - Convert Hourly Wage to Annual Salary
metaDescription: Free hourly to salary calculator. Convert your hourly wage to an annual, monthly, weekly, or daily salary instantly. Perfect for job offer comparisons.
intro: Whether you are comparing job offers, negotiating pay, or simply trying to understand your true earning potential, our free Hourly to Salary Calculator makes the conversion instant and accurate. Enter your hourly wage and the number of hours you work per week, and the tool automatically calculates your equivalent annual salary, monthly earnings, weekly pay, and daily wage. No complex math required — just your numbers.
whatIs: An hourly to salary calculator is a conversion tool that transforms your hourly pay rate into equivalent annual, monthly, weekly, and daily compensation figures. It is most useful when comparing a job that pays by the hour against a salaried position, or when you want to understand the full-year value of your current hourly wage. The standard assumption in most countries is that full-time work equals 40 hours per week and 52 weeks per year, giving 2,080 working hours per year. However, our tool lets you adjust the hours per week for part-time or overtime scenarios.
howToUse: Enter your Hourly Wage — the amount you earn per hour before taxes.
Enter your Hours per Week — typically 40 for full-time, or your actual weekly schedule.
Optionally adjust the Weeks per Year if you take unpaid leave (default is 52).
Click 'Calculate' to instantly see your Annual Salary, Monthly, Weekly, and Daily equivalent.
howItWorks: The calculator multiplies your hourly wage by hours worked per week and then by the number of weeks per year: Annual Salary = Hourly Wage × Hours per Week × Weeks per Year. Monthly is the annual figure divided by 12. Weekly is hourly × hours per week. Daily is hourly × (hours per week ÷ 5).
workedExample: You earn $25 per hour, work 40 hours per week, and take 2 weeks of unpaid vacation (50 working weeks per year). Annual Salary = $25 × 40 × 50 = $50,000. Monthly = $50,000 ÷ 12 = $4,166.67. Weekly = $25 × 40 = $1,000. Daily = $25 × 8 = $200.
resultInterpretation: The annual salary figure is the most commonly used metric for comparing job offers. Monthly salary helps with budgeting, since most bills are monthly. Daily and weekly figures are useful for freelancers and contract workers who are paid by the day or week. Remember, all figures shown are gross (pre-tax) unless your input wage already accounts for taxes.
useCases: Job Offer Comparison: Compare a salaried position with an hourly job to determine which pays more.
Freelance Rate Setting: Calculate whether your freelance hourly rate is competitive with full-time salaried roles.
Raise Negotiation: Show the annual value of a small hourly raise to justify a salary increase.
Part-Time Planning: Calculate your annual earnings from a part-time job with fewer than 40 hours per week.
Benefits Evaluation: Compare total compensation by adding the value of benefits to a gross salary equivalent.
tipsAndLimitations: These calculations are gross (before-tax) figures. Your actual take-home pay will be lower after income tax, Social Security, Medicare, and other deductions.
The standard full-time year assumes 52 weeks × 40 hours = 2,080 hours. Adjust weeks per year to account for unpaid leave.
Salaried employees may receive additional benefits (health insurance, retirement, paid leave) not captured in an hourly comparison.
Overtime rates (1.5× or 2×) can significantly change annual earnings — factor these in if you regularly work overtime.

faq.question: How many working hours are in a year?
faq.answer: A standard full-time work year is 2,080 hours (40 hours per week × 52 weeks). Some calculations subtract paid holidays, arriving at approximately 2,000 hours.

faq.question: Does this calculator include taxes?
faq.answer: No, all results are gross (pre-tax) amounts. To estimate take-home pay, you must deduct federal, state/provincial, and local taxes, as well as Social Security and Medicare contributions.

faq.question: What hourly rate equals a $50,000 salary?
faq.answer: Dividing $50,000 by 2,080 hours gives approximately $24.04 per hour for a standard full-time schedule.

faq.question: How do I calculate monthly salary from hourly?
faq.answer: Multiply your hourly wage by hours per week to get weekly pay, multiply by 52 for annual salary, then divide by 12 for monthly salary.

cta: Convert your hourly wage to annual salary instantly and know your true earning value!
disclaimer: All salary figures are gross estimates before taxes and deductions. Actual net pay will vary based on jurisdiction, tax bracket, and employer deductions.
